description: This file defines Swagger API response schemas for collateral-related endpoints in the Fineract project, including responses for getting, posting, putting, and deleting collateral data.

classes.name: CollateralsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes defining Swagger response schemas for collateral API endpoints.

classes.name: GetLoansLoanIdCollateralsResponse
classes.description: Schema for GET collateral response, including collateral type and currency details.

classes.name: PostLoansLoanIdCollateralsResponse
classes.description: Schema for POST collateral response, returning resource ID.

classes.name: PutLoansLoanIdCollateralsCollateralIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for PUT collateral update response, including changes.

classes.name: DeleteLoansLoanIdCollateralsCollateralIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for DELETE collateral response, confirming resource deletion.
